title: P8-D desktop preflight after reported unlock
trigger: The user reported unlocking the macOS session after the previous P8-D preflight failed.

screenCapture.result: Failed: could not create image from display.

retryAfterReportedUnlock.trigger: The user reported that the macOS session was being unlocked.
retryAfterReportedUnlock.result: Failed: could not create image from display.

bundleSearch.interpretation: A LibreCAD 2 bundle is present in the development tree but is not registered by Launch Services. Display access is still unavailable, so no GUI launch or interaction was attempted.

disposition.nextTrigger: A successful screen capture from the active desktop session; an unlock report without accessible display capture is not a retry trigger.
disposition.nextAction: Once display capture works, launch the explicit LibreCAD 2 bundle path, complete the Move/Copy action-boundary and named-LTYPE checks, then run the LibreCAD_3 MPOLYGON round trip if that application becomes available.
